newsitem.title: australia: Cricket-Victoria 162 all out against Queensland.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Victoria 162 all out against Queensland.

text.p: Victoria were bowled out for a paltry 162 shortly after tea on the first day of their Sheffield Shield match against Queensland on Friday.
Opener Brad Hodge top-scored for Victoria with 45. Acting captain Dean Jones, who won the toss and elected to bat, was out leg before wicket to Andrew Bichel for a duck.
Victoria's total could have been even lower but for the contribution of tail-enders Brad Stacey and Brad Williams. Stacey finished on 26 not out and Williams added 31 before falling to Bichel.
Bichel finished with 5-46, while Adam Dale and Scott Muller took two wickets each.
In Adelaide, South Australia lost two wickets in five balls to be 161 for five at tea against Western Australia.
Darren Lehmann and James Brayshaw took South Australia from 80 for three to 150 before Brayshaw was dismissed by Brendon Julian for 27. Lehmann was then bowled by spinner Brad Hogg for 47.
Geoff Parker and Joe Scuderi were the not out batsman.
In Hobart, New South Wales were 136 for four at tea after axed test opener Michael Slater was out for 76.
Kevin Roberts was unbeaten on 20 and New South Wales captain Greg Matthews was nine not out.
Over an hour of play had been lost during two rain delays.
